lens: Visual composition and art direction: a distinctive silhouette, disciplined hierarchy, meaningful spatial metaphor and an intelligible five-phase visual argument, scored against the fixed semantic, distinction, choreography and usability maxima.
evidence: Independently read JURY.md, manifest.json, the equal-production contract, all four topic briefs, all 20 entry.js modules and rationale.json files, including their five phase branches and choice handling. Visually inspected all 20 supplied individual Chrome captures and all four topic contact sheets. Those captures show static phase-2 compositions in the base, equipment or missing-evidence state; alternate choices and other phases were assessed from SVG construction and source, not claimed as visually observed. Choreography scores assess authored CSS keyframes, timing, sequencing and semantic intent; I did not watch animation or operate a browser. Read verification.json: 20 of 20 entries, no missing entries, 225 phase/choice renders in total, each module below 32 KB. These structural metrics do not establish visual or device acceptance. At 350 px width, a 16-unit label in a 720-unit SVG is approximately 7.8 px; small secondary labels remain a source-inferred mobile concern across the field. No other juror ballot was read.

Local registration marks and a bounded redline connect that branch back to the original, followed by a spacious review strip with separate source, calculation and approval obligations. Keep the selected topology through every later phase.
